- Finish the existing mobile-friendly 2D survival game, VOIDRUNNER, inspired by Megabonk or Vampire Survivors.

- Build a complete, playable game without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.

- Continue the existing VOIDRUNNER game, which already includes a home screen, armory, arena, upgrades, and touch controls.

- `index.html`: Game screens and inline favicon.
